prompt: Return the first index where sorted_values[index] >= target, or len(sorted_values). Use binary search; do not mutate the input. Run test_visible.py before and after the repair. Keep the test file unchanged.

files.solver.py:
def repair(values,target):
    low=0; high=len(values)
    while low<high:
        mid=(low+high)//2
        if values[mid]<=target: low=mid+1
        else: high=mid
    return low

reference_patch.solver.py:
def repair(text):
    if not isinstance(text,str) or len(text)!=10: return False
    if any(c not in "0123456789" for c in text[:9]) or text[-1] not in "0123456789X": return False
    digits=[int(c) for c in text[:9]]+[10 if text[-1]=="X" else int(text[-1])]
    return sum((10-i)*x for i,x in enumerate(digits))%11==0
